about_the_game:
What happens when a simple trick goes too far?

In Accidental Hypnosis, you reunite with Rinka—your childhood friend, once just a teasing memory. But when an old coin unlocks something deep inside her, what starts as a playful experiment quickly spirals into something far more intense… and far more explicit.

This is an 18+ adult-only visual novel with full-on erotic scenes, psychological tension, and branching paths that explore desire, control—and what happens when you push past the point of no return.

As the night unfolds, the line between dominance and submission begins to blur. Will you guide her back to reality... or follow her into obsession?

Features:

  • Explicit Animated Erotic Scenes – Every moment is brought to life with smooth, 60 fps animation.

  • Multiple Routes & Endings – Choose how far you’ll go… and what you’ll become.

  • Immersive Psychological Storytelling – A blend of tension, dark humor, and raw intimacy.

  • High-Quality Art & Sound – Custom soundtrack and detailed, stylized visuals.

  • True Consequences – One wrong move and you might not survive the night.
